title: Atlantic Climbing School
specs: All guides are AMGA certified with expert knowledge of Acadia climbing routes
Courses run 7 days a week with half day (4 hours) and full day (8 hours) options
All participants must complete and sign a liability and medical waiver; minors require parent/guardian signature
Clients must disclose any medical conditions, allergies, injuries, surgeries, or medications
Family courses accommodate up to 6 participants per guide; additional guides available for groups of 5 or more with extra charges
includes: All necessary climbing equipment: climbing shoes, harness, helmet, ropes, and hardware
gap: Exact prices for courses not stated on website
blurb: Guests participate in rock climbing courses tailored to all ages and abilities, including family courses and skill development programs. Courses include instruction on climbing techniques, safety, and climbing multiple routes. All necessary climbing equipment is provided.
extraNote: Cancellation policy available on website; same-day reservations require calling the office · Tipping is not expected but appreciated · Meet at the office on Cottage Street in Bar Harbor for check-in and gear fitting.
